title: C7 clean-room intent-review verdict
description: Fresh-context judgment of a leaf's diff AGAINST the node's issue/spec intent (spec §3.1) — distinct from C4's lens-based code review. The judge asks: does the change actually deliver what the issue/spec asked for, nothing more, nothing less? Feeds the node-gate alongside the review chain and spec-validate.

verdict.description: pass = the diff faithfully delivers the intent. review = partial/uncertain match needing human eyes. fail = the diff does not deliver the intent (missing, wrong, or scope-creeping).

findings.description: Intent mismatches. Required when verdict is review/fail; may be empty on pass.

severity.description: blocker = intent not delivered; warning = partial/risky; info = observation.

description.description: What aspect of the issue/spec intent the diff fails to deliver (or over-delivers), with reference to the relevant criterion.
